tasks.short: Operate telephone systems to complete caller connections

steps.what: Clarify caller connection request and need for immediate human assistance
Look up destination and applicable connection instructions
Choose appropriate connection and resolve ambiguous requests
Advance and complete the checked telephone connection
Monitor connection success and assist callers with failures
outputs: completed assistance or manually resolved failure

tasks.design: Configure native directory search and supported connection shortcuts in {TELEPHONY}. The operator hears every request, chooses the destination and executes the checked transfer; emergency and accessibility assistance remain human throughout.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operators navigate separate directory views and repeat connection controls.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and connection controls can reduce mechanical lookup and button handling.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous destinations, emergencies, person-to-person requests and callers needing personal assistance.
tasks.human_edge: Calm judgement and responsive help when the connection is consequential.
tasks.altitude: Less console navigation while retaining caller assistance.

reach.learn: Check the destination before a consequential handoff

evidence.claim: The digest describes Teams Dial by Name support for partial names and multiple-match disambiguation; this supports directory search, not emergency-call classification.
The proposed marginal lookup and console savings are E1 scenarios, not the digest's hospital workload result.

assumptions: Includes request clarification, directory lookup, destination choice, actual connection and failed-call assistance; call-charge record tasks are separate when required.

The operator produces request name, location and assistance needs in s1 and checked destination number in s2-s3, with capture time counted. The directory owner produces name, department, number and update timestamp during directory maintenance, priced in task13257. Missing or ambiguous entries use manual assistance; no structured emergency flag is assumed.
Native directory and console settings come first; no voicebot, automated emergency classification or unlisted machine transfer.
Connection controls are priced as a real transfer, not a same-system save. Existing platform call logging is already in place and offers no new saving here.
unknowns: Mix of ordinary and emergency or assisted calls
Directory update delay and destination quality
research_questions: Do native shortcuts reduce console time while preserving destination checking and failed-call assistance?

incremental.description: Maintain console shortcuts and directory mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact live call, destination number, connection type and caller agreement checked immediately before transfer; changed destination requires a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R87 gross13 less2 upkeep gives central11. Low retains19/20 lookup and24/25 connection handling with stale entries and many special calls: gross2 less2=0. High retains15/20 lookup and21/25 connection handling with current destinations and supported shortcuts: gross9 less2=7. Listening, destination judgement and connection-failure support stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Listen to customer requests and capture name or location clues
Search alphabetical or geographical directories for matching entries
Disambiguate directory matches and check permitted disclosure
Provide checked telephone information to the customer

tasks.design: Configure native name, spelling and location search in {TELEPHONY}. The operator captures the request, resolves multiple matches and provides the final checked information; no model invents a number or bypasses disclosure rules.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directory search requires repeated manual navigation and spelling variants.
tasks.enabler_now: Native partial-name and disambiguation features can shorten the search.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding an uncertain request and distinguishing namesakes or restricted entries.
tasks.altitude: Move effort from directory navigation to resolving difficult requests.

reach.learn: Use location and responsibility to distinguish similar names

evidence.claim: Teams Dial by Name supports spoken full or partial names, multiple matches and department disambiguation in the digest.
The local directory-search time reduction is an E1 estimate.

assumptions: Includes the actual search and answer. This task does not itself connect a call or create a clerical log unless that is observed in the workplace.

Operator captures name spelling, locality and requested detail in s1 and checks the matched source entry in s2-s3; their time remains counted. Directory name, number, location and visibility are produced during task13257 maintenance, with its capture counted there. Missing, stale or ambiguous entries return to manual lookup and clarification.
Use native directory settings and filters first; no generative answer or autonomous disclosure.
Existing platform logging is already today's system work, not new automation or a claimed saving.
unknowns: Current search capability and directory geography coverage
Share of ambiguous or restricted entries
Whether a separate answer log is actually written
research_questions: Does configured search reduce lookup time without increasing wrong or restricted directory answers?

incremental.description: Maintain search fields and test directory freshness

approvals.approved_version: Exact directory entry, number, allowed detail and customer request checked before speaking the answer; changed matches require a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R82.5 gross17.5 less2 upkeep gives central15.5. Low retains32/35 search with incomplete geographical fields and repeated clarification: gross3 less2=1. High retains23/35 search with usable spelling variants and department fields: gross12 less2=10. Request capture, disambiguation and the actual answer stay fully retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Obtain directory changes and capture their source details
Resolve conflicting directory identities, numbers and disclosure permissions
Update directory names, locations, numbers and visibility fields
Check edited directory entries against the verified changes
Save updates in the same directory system

tasks.design: Configure linked source views and a concise native directory entry form in {TELEPHONY}, using {HCM} only where it is the authorised source. Keep identity and visibility decisions human; the same-system save stays fully retained without author self-approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified source details are repeatedly located and re-keyed into directory fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views and consistent edit forms can reduce navigation and repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting identities, stale source information and whether a number may be disclosed.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving discrepancies with the responsible source owner.
tasks.altitude: More reliable directory maintenance with less re-keying.

reach.learn: Preserve source identity and effective dates

evidence.claim: The digest notes that Teams directory search can lag updates; maintenance must not assume an edited record is immediately searchable.
Native source-view and manual-entry improvements are E1 estimates rather than a demonstrated automatic directory integration.

assumptions: Baseline includes source lookup, discrepancy resolution, directory writing, checking and a small ordinary save. It does not create a separate publication send.

The source owner creates the authorised personnel or contact change as part of their own record-maintenance task, with capture counted there. The operator in s1 captures source identifier, name, number, location, effective date and visibility permission and checks them in s2; s3 records the directory update. All operator capture time is counted; absent permissions or conflicting fields require manual resolution.
Native linked views and edit forms come first; no implicit automatic sync, machine write or outside-directory publication is named.
Existing automatic updates have no new eligible benefit. Ordinary author save time is fully retained at1 percent, with no gate.
unknowns: Authoritative source for each directory field
Existing identity sync and directory form features
research_questions: Can native views reduce re-key time while preserving identity, effective date and visibility?

incremental.description: Maintain field views and check schema changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R80 gross20 less2 upkeep gives central18. Low retains all20 source handling and38/40 editing when identifiers or visibility fields do not match: gross2 less2=0. High retains17/20 source handling and30/40 editing with compatible source fields and a useful native edit layout: gross13 less2=11. Conflict resolution, final check and same-system save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect clerical requests and identify document or mail destinations
Perform typing using supplied text and routine layouts
Proofread typed documents against supplied source material
Sort electronic and physical mail by confirmed destination
outputs: sorted mail bundles and electronic groups

steps.what: Deliver checked documents and sorted mail to colleagues
inputs: sorted mail bundles and electronic groups

tasks.design: Configure native text snippets and layouts in {DOCS}, and destination views in {EMAIL}. Typing, proofreading, sorting and actual delivery retain separate effort; physical mail handling and final recipient checking remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated typing and electronic destination handling consume time alongside physical clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native text reuse and mailbox views can reduce repetition for the electronic portion.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding unusual requests, catching meaningful errors and handling confidential mail correctly.
tasks.human_edge: Careful comparison and discretion about destinations.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repetitive typing without weakening proofreading or mail handling.

reach.learn: Check the actual content and destination together

evidence.claim: Native document snippets and mailbox views may reduce repetitive typing and electronic sorting; no clerical time case is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Includes real document writing and mail delivery. Physical sorting remains fully retained within the mixed sorting step; only repeated electronic handling is eligible for its proposed reduction.

The operator produces understood requests and destinations in s1, enters source text in s2 and checks it in s3. Sender, recipient, subject and destination are read and confirmed during s1 and s4, with capture time counted. Missing or ambiguous destinations are clarified manually; no pre-existing structured routing code is assumed.
Native layouts, snippets and mailbox views come first; there is no implicit machine scan, automatic forwarding, document send or mail move.
Ordinary same-system author saves are retained inside typing and have no self-approval or saving.
unknowns: Proportion of electronic versus physical mail
Whether document delivery is internal or external
research_questions: Do native snippets and views reduce clerical time without increasing source-text or recipient errors?

incremental.description: Maintain snippets, layouts and destination views

approvals.approved_version: Exact checked document or mail bundle and colleague destination before each delivery; changes require a new final-item check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R87 gross13 less2 upkeep gives central11. Low retains28/30 typing andall20 sorting when text is mostly unique and mail physical: gross2 less2=0. High retains24/30 typing and17/20 sorting with reusable supplied text and a meaningful electronic-mail portion: gross9 less2=7. Intake judgement, proofreading and real delivery stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native directory, console and clerical configuration to reduce repetition while retaining callers' needs and disclosure judgement.
role.ambitious_version: A telephone operator with more attention for difficult callers and fewer repetitive console and record operations.
